verdict: Ad efficiency is up; several setup milestones need to be closed out.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $6,919.64 in revenue on $1,397.80 in spend — a 4.95x return that improved 18.7% versus the prior week, with purchases up 40% week-over-week. The ad side of the business is running well, and the efficiency trend through Oct 23–25 confirms that momentum is real. On the setup side, several agreed milestones — including funnel testing, automation flows, subscribe pages, and the first monthly report — are overdue and are being prioritized for completion now. You can expect those to close out ahead of the October 31 review, which will also bring subscription lifecycle automations and the next phase of Meta scaling online.
